items.text: Compact date badge — a date pill (8 jun · 14:03) appears in the header on phone when the full date line is hidden; tap to open the date/weather popover.
Page swipe hint — a pulsing ← → indicator below the tab strip hints at horizontal swipe when you have multiple pages on touch.
Scroll-snap tabs — page tabs scroll horizontally with snap on narrow screens; the active tab scrolls into view automatically.
Category name tooltip — long category titles truncate with an ellipsis; hover reveals the full name.
Empty category text — the raw locale key was shown instead of the translated "no bookmarks yet" text when the key was missing.
Letter avatar — bookmarks without a favicon show a styled initial-letter tile instead of a blank icon.
Inline edit improvements — long-press inline edit shows field-level validation errors, dismisses on ESC or click-outside, and warns before discarding unsaved changes.
Note line-clamp — bookmark preview-card notes are capped at three lines; longer notes are hidden with an ellipsis.
ESC hint in modals — a subtle ESC to close hint appears below modal buttons on pointer devices.
Skeleton loader — the recent bookmarks modal (*) shows a shimmer skeleton while data loads.
Spring animations — search entrance and drag-and-drop placeholder use spring cubic-bezier curves for a smoother feel.
Theme preview badge — the "Preview" badge in the theme editor now uses an accent-color background with a pulsing dot.
Font upload icons — custom font status shows ✓ or ✕ after upload.
Focus-visible outlines — search pill buttons and history chips now show a visible focus ring on keyboard navigation.
Hide empty categories — Config → General → Bookmarks; on by default. Categories with no bookmarks are hidden from the dashboard. Existing installs are migrated automatically.
Bookmark name tooltip — truncated bookmark titles show the full name on hover via the native tooltip.
Search result ellipsis — long names in the search overlay now truncate cleanly with an ellipsis and tooltip.
Notification queue — rapid notifications are queued and shown one at a time with a fade gap; no more simultaneous toasts.
prefers-reduced-motion — spring curves, pulse animations, and entrance effects respect the OS reduced-motion setting across the whole UI.
Collapsed category state — localStorage errors (private browsing, quota) no longer break collapse persistence; state is kept in-memory for the session.
